findings.key_quote: Overall revenue during fiscal 2025 increased in all geographic regions as compared to fiscal 2024.
findings.justification: This passage directly states that revenue grew in all geographic regions during fiscal 2025 compared to fiscal 2024, which entails the portion of the claim about revenue growing in every region.

The derived metric shows revenue year-over-year growth of approximately 10.5% for fiscal 2025, confirming revenue increased.
The table shows total revenue increased 11% in fiscal 2025 compared to fiscal 2024, confirming year-over-year revenue growth.
